description: This file defines a React functional component 'FileComponent' responsible for rendering a file preview within a rich text editor environment. The component integrates with lexical editor context, manages lazy loading using IntersectionObserver, and displays a file preview if the relevant file is found in the application state.

methods.name: FileComponent
methods.description: React functional component that renders a file preview with lazy loading and zoom controls, integrated within a lexical-based editor environment.

methods.name: setImageZoomLevel
methods.description: Callback to update the zoom level of the image within the editor.
